pilot_execution_contract.scope: Representative #1558 local-path artifact-only move; no QEMU, CAS activation, RE, credential, or cluster mutation.

move_plan.selection_caveat: Because origin/dev never contained the branch-only old_path, automatic merge-base selection can classify this artifact-only plan as already landed. The executor must pass --plan explicitly to apply, dry-run, reverse dry-run, and materialization. A post-move CI-derived manifest may be empty for that reason and is not population evidence.

population_contract.implementation_pattern: The Rust verdict target //storage/adapters/local-path:local-path-contract declares every observed YAML and the probe through Buck2 resources plus env $(location ...); it performs no repository-root filesystem reads. New YAML-owning packages separately use the canonical corpus_yaml_facts_shards declaration so the corpus graph owns their complete YAML sets. The extraction genrules are indexing siblings, not an implied dependency of the Rust verdict.

count_semantics.rule: Exactly one structurally parsed StorageClass/local-path provider exists in either infra/gitops/local-path-storage.yaml (pre) or storage/adapters/local-path/local-path-storage.yaml (post/promoted); never both.

Exactly one structurally parsed storageClassName=local-path edge in each of infra/nativelink/nativelink-cas.k8s.yaml, infra/registry/registry.k8s.yaml, infra/seaweedfs/seaweedfs.k8s.yaml, and oya/observability/iac/k8s/helm/values.yaml.

The metadata.name=local-path-storage Application in infra/gitops/bootstrap-sync.yaml has spec.source.path equal to the phase path and spec.source.directory.include exactly local-path-storage.yaml. Do not count generic path: infra/gitops text because another Application uses it.

positive_probe.shape: A committed differently shaped StatefulSet values-style fixture with one nested volumeClaimTemplates[*].spec.storageClassName=local-path edge; it is not a copy of the provider manifest or GitOps Application.
positive_probe.mechanism: The Rust test asserts live inputs=6, live inputs plus the explicit probe fixture=7, and live inputs after probe exclusion=6. corpus_yaml_facts_shards keeps YAML in the Buck graph; Rust supplies the verdict.

package_indexing.declaration: retain the existing canonical corpus_yaml_facts_shards declaration

verdict_binding.mechanism: rust_test resources plus one env $(location <label>) per input; no ambient path discovery
verdict_binding.assertion: the same Rust logic derives live=6, live+probe=7, after probe exclusion=6 solely from declared inputs

pre: set -o pipefail; PRE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD); buck2 test //storage/adapters/local-path:local-path-contract 2>&1 | tee ".omx/tmp/g039/${PRE_SHA}.pre-local-path-contract.log"
post: set -o pipefail; POST_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD); buck2 test //storage/adapters/local-path:local-path-contract 2>&1 | tee ".omx/tmp/g039/${POST_SHA}.post-local-path-contract.log"
promoted: PROMOTED_SHA=$(cat .omx/tmp/g039/promoted-head.txt) && CHECK_URL=$(gh api "repos/jason931225/oyatie/commits/${PROMOTED_SHA}/check-runs" --jq '[.check_runs[] | select(.name=="oya-ci-required" and .conclusion=="success")][-1].html_url // empty') && test -n "$CHECK_URL" && printf '%s\n' "$CHECK_URL" | tee ".omx/tmp/g039/${PROMOTED_SHA}.oya-ci-required-url.txt"
commands.authority_note: Rust/Buck2 tests and the codemod are reproducible local evidence. Only independent review plus exact-head protected oya-ci-required is merge authority.
